run_m4t_evaluate: run the m4t_evaluate CLI to evaluate SeamlessM4T multilingual speech-to-text translation models
run_m4t_predict: run the m4t_predict CLI to generate predictions using SeamlessM4T translation models
run_m4t_finetune: run the m4t_finetune CLI to fine-tune SeamlessM4T models on custom datasets
run_m4t_prepare_dataset: run the m4t_prepare_dataset CLI to prepare datasets for SeamlessM4T finetuning
run_m4t_audio_to_units: run the m4t_audio_to_units CLI to convert audio input to discrete units
